title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Parco della Musica, Rome | 2018
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Parco della Musica in Rome, Italy, on 11 July 2018.

It was the 23rd show of the 13th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and North America, which lasted for 44 dates between June and September 2018, and the last show of the European leg of the tour.

Thank you Rome for a great night I send everybody at the gig peace and love and everybody in the band peace and love ???????????? pic.twitter.com/PADRtoama9

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) July 11, 2018

This was Starr’s second show at the Parco della Musica. He previously performed at the venue on 4 July 2011.

The 13th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Graham Gouldman: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
